notes.val_seeds: Chosen before any training: the last 15 bulk seeds and the last 5 of each hard-case set of render run v1, so validation has the same mix as training. Never test seeds. Seed 111 left validation on 2026-10-19 (25 to 24 clips): it failed the render checks twice (b319f21 and cca498c) and dataset v1 excludes it (docs/eval/dataset-v1.json). It was removed, not replaced, because choosing a substitute after seeing results would be choosing the validation set by them. ours-v2 validated on all 25 (its train-manifest.json). Unchanged for round 1: the 24 validation clips stay dataset v1's, and every new clip trains, so both runs stop early on the same clips; choosing new validation clips after seeing round 1 would be choosing them by it.
notes.stride: Every 5th frame (5 fps): nearer frames are near copies of each other.
notes.resolution: 640, divisible by patch 16 x windows 2. At the default 512 the median ball is 7.1 px (docs/eval/dataset-stats.json); 640 gives about 8.9 px for a 1.6x cost. Larger is a measured ablation, not a default.
notes.batch: 4 images, gradients accumulated 4 times: an effective batch of 16, rfdetr's default target. It was 2 x 8 (the same optimisation, half the memory) while training on a 24 GB Mac, where 4 x 4 took about 18 GB of unified memory; a 24 GB GPU holds 4 x 4.
notes.epochs: Up to 8 with early stopping (patience 3): the model already detects players and the ball after 30 epochs of v2/v2los; this adapts it to engine-v1 renders. Set before the run.
notes.seed: Fixed so a rerun on the same data gives the same model, up to GPU nondeterminism.
notes.num_workers: 8 data-loading workers on the GPU machine: with 2 the RTX 4090 sat at 13-23% busy while the loader ran at 90% CPU. Speed only; the data and the order of training are unchanged.
notes.purpose: Targeted round 1 (docs/eval/round1/PLAN.md): ours-v4 and ours-v4-ctrl both continue from ours-v3 (--init) with every setting of finetune-short.json, on dataset v1 plus 80 clips rendered at 91d1e3b: the 80 targeted clips of round 1 (docs/eval/dataset-v2-round1.json) or 80 untargeted clips on the seeds' own draws (docs/eval/dataset-v2-ctrl.json). Only those 80 clips differ between the two runs, so v4 minus v4-ctrl on the mesh test set is the effect of targeting. Set before either run.
notes.lr: Half of finetune.json's (5e-5, encoder 7.5e-5), the usual choice when continuing from a trained checkpoint, so the adaptation does not undo what it learned. Set before the run.
